Name: guild_agent_card_revisions
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_agent_card_revisions (
    CardId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK((CardId=upper(CardId) AND length(CardId)=36 AND substr(CardId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CardId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CardId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CardId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Revision > 0),
    ContentId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((ContentId=upper(ContentId) AND length(ContentId)=36 AND substr(ContentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ContentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ContentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ContentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    SourceDigest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(SourceDigest AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(CardId,Revision)
);

Name: guild_agent_card_skills
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_agent_card_skills (
    CardId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK((CardId=upper(CardId) AND length(CardId)=36 AND substr(CardId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CardId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CardId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CardId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),

    SkillId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(SkillId AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    Ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Ordinal >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY(CardId,Revision,Ordinal)
);

Name: guild_agent_cards
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_agent_cards (
    IssuedSequence INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    CardId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((CardId=upper(CardId) AND length(CardId)=36 AND substr(CardId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CardId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CardId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CardId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    AgentId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((AgentId=upper(AgentId) AND length(AgentId)=36 AND substr(AgentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(AgentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(AgentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(AgentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(AgentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(AgentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND AgentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    ExplicitAgentId TEXT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((ExplicitAgentId IS NULL OR (ExplicitAgentId=upper(ExplicitAgentId) AND length(ExplicitAgentId)=36 AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ExplicitAgentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ExplicitAgentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ExplicitAgentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    SourceKindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(SourceKindCode BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
    SourceIdentity TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(CAST(SourceIdentity AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    WorkspaceId TEXT NULL CHECK((WorkspaceId IS NULL OR (WorkspaceId=upper(WorkspaceId) AND length(WorkspaceId)=36 AND substr(WorkspaceId,9,1)='-' AND substr(WorkspaceId,14,1)='-' AND substr(WorkspaceId,19,1)='-' AND substr(WorkspaceId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(WorkspaceId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(WorkspaceId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND WorkspaceId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    PeerId TEXT NULL CHECK(PeerId IS NULL OR (length(CAST(PeerId AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536)),
    SessionId TEXT NULL CHECK((SessionId IS NULL OR (SessionId=upper(SessionId) AND length(SessionId)=36 AND substr(SessionId,9,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,14,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,19,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(SessionId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(SessionId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND SessionId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    CampaignId TEXT NULL CHECK((CampaignId IS NULL OR (CampaignId=upper(CampaignId) AND length(CampaignId)=36 AND substr(CampaignId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CampaignId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CampaignId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CampaignId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    CurrentRevision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(CurrentRevision > 0),
    ContentId TEXT NULL CHECK((ContentId IS NULL OR (ContentId=upper(ContentId) AND length(ContentId)=36 AND substr(ContentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ContentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ContentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ContentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    Available INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Available IN(0,1)),
    ReasonCode TEXT NULL CHECK(ReasonCode IS NULL OR (length(CAST(ReasonCode AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536)),
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    UpdatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK(SourceKindCode<>2 OR SessionId IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK(SourceKindCode=2 OR (SessionId IS NULL AND CampaignId IS NULL))
);

Name: guild_content
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_content (
    ContentId TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK((ContentId=upper(ContentId) AND length(ContentId)=36 AND substr(ContentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ContentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ContentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ContentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    SessionId TEXT NULL CHECK((SessionId IS NULL OR (SessionId=upper(SessionId) AND length(SessionId)=36 AND substr(SessionId,9,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,14,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,19,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(SessionId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(SessionId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND SessionId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    CampaignId TEXT NULL CHECK((CampaignId IS NULL OR (CampaignId=upper(CampaignId) AND length(CampaignId)=36 AND substr(CampaignId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CampaignId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CampaignId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CampaignId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    ContentKindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ContentKindCode BETWEEN 0 AND 8),
    SourceRecordId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK((SourceRecordId=upper(SourceRecordId) AND length(SourceRecordId)=36 AND substr(SourceRecordId,9,1)='-' AND substr(SourceRecordId,14,1)='-' AND substr(SourceRecordId,19,1)='-' AND substr(SourceRecordId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(SourceRecordId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(SourceRecordId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND SourceRecordId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Revision > 0),
    Digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(Digest)='blob' AND length(Digest)=32),
    MimeType TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(MimeType AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    Body BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(Body)='blob' AND length(Body)<=65536),
    SensitivityCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(SensitivityCode IN(0,1)),
    ProvenanceModeCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ProvenanceModeCode IN(0,1,2)),
    ExactGenerationIds BLOB NULL,
    GenerationBloom BLOB NULL,
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(ContentKindCode,SourceRecordId,Revision),
    CHECK((SensitivityCode=0 AND ProvenanceModeCode=0 AND ExactGenerationIds IS NULL AND GenerationBloom IS NULL)
        OR (SensitivityCode=1 AND ProvenanceModeCode=1 AND ExactGenerationIds IS NOT NULL AND typeof(ExactGenerationIds)='blob' AND length(ExactGenerationIds) BETWEEN 16 AND 128 AND length(ExactGenerationIds)%16=0 AND GenerationBloom IS NULL)
        OR (SensitivityCode=1 AND ProvenanceModeCode=2 AND ExactGenerationIds IS NULL AND GenerationBloom IS NOT NULL AND typeof(GenerationBloom)='blob' AND length(GenerationBloom)=32 AND GenerationBloom<>zeroblob(32)))
);

Name: guild_content_erasure_receipts
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_content_erasure_receipts (
    ContentId TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK((ContentId=upper(ContentId) AND length(ContentId)=36 AND substr(ContentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ContentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ContentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ContentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    SessionId TEXT NULL CHECK((SessionId IS NULL OR (SessionId=upper(SessionId) AND length(SessionId)=36 AND substr(SessionId,9,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,14,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,19,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(SessionId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(SessionId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND SessionId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    CampaignId TEXT NULL CHECK((CampaignId IS NULL OR (CampaignId=upper(CampaignId) AND length(CampaignId)=36 AND substr(CampaignId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CampaignId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CampaignId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CampaignId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    ContentKindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ContentKindCode BETWEEN 0 AND 8),
    SourceRecordId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK((SourceRecordId=upper(SourceRecordId) AND length(SourceRecordId)=36 AND substr(SourceRecordId,9,1)='-' AND substr(SourceRecordId,14,1)='-' AND substr(SourceRecordId,19,1)='-' AND substr(SourceRecordId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(SourceRecordId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(SourceRecordId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND SourceRecordId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Revision > 0),
    Digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(Digest)='blob' AND length(Digest)=32),
    MimeType TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(MimeType AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    ByteLength INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ByteLength BETWEEN 0 AND 65536),
    ErasedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL
);

Name: guild_declared_roots
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_declared_roots (
    RootKey TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(CAST(RootKey AS BLOB))<=64),
    SourceKindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(SourceKindCode IN(0,1)),
    WorkspaceId TEXT NULL CHECK(WorkspaceId IS NULL OR length(WorkspaceId)=36),
    InstallationGeneration TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(InstallationGeneration)=36),
    PathDigest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(PathDigest)=64),
    ScanId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(ScanId)=36),
    StateCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(StateCode IN(0,1,2)),
    CHECK((SourceKindCode=0 AND WorkspaceId IS NULL) OR (SourceKindCode=1 AND WorkspaceId IS NOT NULL))
);

Name: guild_declared_source_claims
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_declared_source_claims (
    SourceIdentity TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    RootKey TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES guild_declared_roots(RootKey) ON DELETE CASCADE CHECK(length(CAST(RootKey AS BLOB))<=64),
    ExplicitAgentId TEXT NULL CHECK(ExplicitAgentId IS NULL OR length(ExplicitAgentId)=36),
    LastSeenScanId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(LastSeenScanId)=36),
    ObservedValid INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ObservedValid IN(0,1)),
    SourceDigest TEXT NULL,
    CHECK((ObservedValid=0 AND SourceDigest IS NULL) OR (ObservedValid=1 AND SourceDigest IS NOT NULL AND length(SourceDigest)=64)),
    CHECK(length(CAST(SourceIdentity AS BLOB))+length(RootKey)+COALESCE(length(ExplicitAgentId),0)+length(LastSeenScanId)+COALESCE(length(SourceDigest),0)<=65536)
);

Name: guild_owner_cleanup
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_owner_cleanup (
    OwnerKindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(OwnerKindCode IN(1,2)),
    OwnerId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK((OwnerId=upper(OwnerId) AND length(OwnerId)=36 AND substr(OwnerId,9,1)='-' AND substr(OwnerId,14,1)='-' AND substr(OwnerId,19,1)='-' AND substr(OwnerId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(OwnerId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(OwnerId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND OwnerId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    EventSequence INTEGER NULL CHECK(EventSequence IS NULL OR EventSequence>0),
    PhaseCode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(PhaseCode BETWEEN 0 AND 6),
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    UpdatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(OwnerKindCode,OwnerId)
);

Name: guild_roster_cursors

Name: guild_signets
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_signets (
    SignetId TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    AgentId TEXT NOT NULL,
    RunId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    CommissionId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    RootCommissionId TEXT NOT NULL,
    IssuerSignetId TEXT NULL REFERENCES guild_signets(SignetId) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    GrantJson TEXT NOT NULL,
    IssuedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    OriginPrincipalId TEXT NOT NULL,
    SessionId TEXT NULL,
    CampaignId TEXT NULL,
    WorkspaceId TEXT NULL,
    WorkspaceIdentityPolicyVersion INTEGER NULL,
    WorkspaceIdentityRevision INTEGER NULL,
    WorkspaceRootIdentity BLOB NULL,
    PeerId TEXT NULL,
    PeerGrantRevision TEXT NULL,
    InstallationGeneration TEXT NOT NULL,
    AuthorityEpoch TEXT NOT NULL,
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(Revision)='integer' AND Revision>=1),
    CredentialGeneration INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(CredentialGeneration)='integer' AND CredentialGeneration>=1),
    TokenDigest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(TokenDigest)='blob' AND length(TokenDigest)=32),
    RevocationGeneration INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(RevocationGeneration)='integer' AND RevocationGeneration>=0),
    Revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Revoked IN(0,1)),
    RestoredInert INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(RestoredInert IN(0,1)),
    Retired INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Retired IN(0,1)),
    CancellationRequested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(CancellationRequested IN(0,1)),
    CHECK((CommissionId=RootCommissionId AND IssuerSignetId IS NULL) OR (CommissionId<>RootCommissionId AND IssuerSignetId IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK((PeerId IS NULL)=(PeerGrantRevision IS NULL)),
    CHECK((WorkspaceId IS NULL AND WorkspaceIdentityPolicyVersion IS NULL AND WorkspaceIdentityRevision IS NULL AND WorkspaceRootIdentity IS NULL)
       OR (WorkspaceId IS NOT NULL AND WorkspaceIdentityPolicyVersion IS NOT NULL AND WorkspaceIdentityRevision IS NOT NULL
           AND WorkspaceIdentityPolicyVersion>=1 AND WorkspaceIdentityRevision>=1 AND typeof(WorkspaceRootIdentity)='blob' AND length(WorkspaceRootIdentity)=32))
);

Name: guild_agent_card_revisions_guard_update
guild_content_erasure_receipts_guard_update
guild_content_guard_delete
Sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guild_content_guard_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON guild_content
WHEN (OLD.SensitivityCode <> 0 OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM artifact_sensitivity
    WHERE ArtifactKindCode = 17 AND lower(replace(ArtifactId,'-','')) = lower(replace(OLD.ContentId,'-',''))))
    AND arcanum_sensitivity_purge_authorized() = 0
    AND arcanum_covenant_family_maintenance_authorized() = 0
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Protected Guild content deletion requires its protected erasure authority.');
END;

Name: guild_content_guard_insert
Sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guild_content_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON guild_content
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM guild_content_erasure_receipts WHERE ContentId=NEW.ContentId)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM guild_content_erasure_receipts
        WHERE ContentKindCode=NEW.ContentKindCode AND SourceRecordId=NEW.SourceRecordId AND Revision=NEW.Revision)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'An erased Guild content identity or immutable revision cannot be resurrected.');
END;

Name: guild_content_guard_update
guild_roster_cursors_guard_update
guild_roster_refreshes_guard_update
guild_signet_revocations_guard_update
guild_signets_guard_update
Sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guild_signets_guard_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON guild_signets
WHEN NEW.SignetId IS NOT OLD.SignetId
  OR NEW.AgentId IS NOT OLD.AgentId
  OR NEW.RunId IS NOT OLD.RunId
  OR NEW.CommissionId IS NOT OLD.CommissionId
  OR NEW.RootCommissionId IS NOT OLD.RootCommissionId
  OR NEW.IssuerSignetId IS NOT OLD.IssuerSignetId
  OR NEW.GrantJson IS NOT OLD.GrantJson
  OR NEW.IssuedAtUtc IS NOT OLD.IssuedAtUtc
  OR NEW.OriginPrincipalId IS NOT OLD.OriginPrincipalId
  OR NEW.SessionId IS NOT OLD.SessionId
  OR NEW.CampaignId IS NOT OLD.CampaignId
  OR NEW.WorkspaceId IS NOT OLD.WorkspaceId
  OR NEW.WorkspaceIdentityPolicyVersion IS NOT OLD.WorkspaceIdentityPolicyVersion
  OR NEW.WorkspaceIdentityRevision IS NOT OLD.WorkspaceIdentityRevision
  OR NEW.WorkspaceRootIdentity IS NOT OLD.WorkspaceRootIdentity
  OR NEW.PeerId IS NOT OLD.PeerId
  OR NEW.PeerGrantRevision IS NOT OLD.PeerGrantRevision
  OR NEW.InstallationGeneration IS NOT OLD.InstallationGeneration
  OR NEW.AuthorityEpoch IS NOT OLD.AuthorityEpoch
  OR NEW.Revision<>OLD.Revision+1
  OR NEW.CredentialGeneration<OLD.CredentialGeneration
  OR NEW.CredentialGeneration>OLD.CredentialGeneration+1
  OR ((NEW.TokenDigest IS NOT OLD.TokenDigest)<>(NEW.CredentialGeneration=OLD.CredentialGeneration+1))
  OR NEW.RevocationGeneration<OLD.RevocationGeneration
  OR NEW.RevocationGeneration>OLD.RevocationGeneration+1
  OR NEW.Revoked<OLD.Revoked
  OR NEW.RestoredInert<OLD.RestoredInert
  OR NEW.Retired<OLD.Retired
  OR NEW.CancellationRequested<OLD.CancellationRequested
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Guild Signet identity and denial evidence are immutable.');
END;

Name: guild_utc_instant_columns
